findings.scenario: Observe whether NOAA watches and warnings, observed geomagnetic storm scale, and reported anomalies in grid, navigation, communications, or spacecraft systems moves in the direction of concern: Earth-directed events forecast at severe or extreme levels with correlated system anomalies
findings.observationCadence: daily automated public alert check and annual exercise review
findings.measurableTrigger: A severe NOAA watch or a newly identified unmitigated dependency
findings.boundedResponse: Maintain a tested offline continuity checklist and simulate loss of time, navigation, communications, and grid dependencies
findings.rollback: Restore the prior checklist and preserve simulation failures as evidence
findings.authorityBoundary: Automation may monitor public alerts and run local simulations. Operational control of grids, radio, spacecraft, or emergency services remains outside scope and requires separately verified authorization; contact a human only for an irreducible owner-controlled action.
